_contract: Shared cross-language fixture for which characters of a pattern string are variables. The rule: exactly X, Y, Z or # — and a letter touching any lowercase letter (Unicode Ll) is literal text, so the X in "Xích" or the P in "iPhone" is never a placeholder; # always counts. Asserted by src/utils/__tests__/PatternVariable.parity.test.js against PatternTemplateEngine.isVariableChar (which the validator and the JS fallback matcher both call) and by wasm-core/src/pattern_processor/variable.rs against is_variable_at (which parser.rs and build_result both call). Until 2026-09-26 the Rust parser took any A-Z, the JS fallback matcher any A-Z but never #, and the validator only X/Y/Z/# — so VIP的X validated as one variable and matched as four. Indices count Unicode code points; every case is BMP-only so JS and Rust agree on them.

cases.name: a capital fused to lowercase is literal
template letter fused to a Vietnamese word
